grade.went_well: The answer lists affected realizations, not just modules, and separates default from non-default realizations, checked against main.gms. All line citations are accurate. It uses not_used.txt to rule out the other 40_techpol realizations, and it correctly notes that module bounds run after core bounds (loop.gms ordering). It also states the limits of its own search: derived parameters such as pm_regiEarlyRetiRate were not traced.
grade.answer_key_issues: The key leaves out q_transPe2se (core/equations.gms:174-180), which also multiplies by (1 - vm_capEarlyReti). It also leaves out the Execute_Loadpoint in core/preloop.gms:100. The answer correctly includes both.
grade.summary: The answer is accurate and complete. It names the realizations that use vm_capEarlyReti (47_regipol/regiCarbonPrice and none, 70_water/heat, 40_techpol/NDCplus) and every core use site, with correct line numbers and default status. The only gap is minor: it doesn't mention that the tnrs bounds in regiCarbonPrice are gated by cm_NucRegiPol, which is on by default.
